clean: User story: As a store manager, I want to see daily sales broken down by hour so that I can schedule staff. Acceptance criteria are that the chart covers the last seven days, the hours are shown in the store's local time zone, the data refreshes every 5 minutes, and the page loads in under 3 seconds with up to 10,000 orders. Out of scope are weekly reports and exports.
